name: The Needle bomber, the Glasswright bomber wing craft (The Glasswrights)
notes: Issue 1373 (R362; Ryan picked GF1 on Nov 20 2026): the Glasswright bomber wing craft (the bomber of the GF1 family), built from the build sheet tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/ithar_GB1.py (which builds the GF1 body at bomber proportions) on the shared Glasswright kit (tools/blender/kits/ithar): pearl ribbons, silver edges, the glowing mosaic core (the emission atlas) and cut stones; nothing see-through; no wear. LENGTH 1.6 (CLS_LEN Squadron). The game loads it through godot/render/squadron_wing.gd by its manifest wing_role (bomber).
